title: The Non-Determinism of Small LLMs: Evidence of Low Answer Consistency in Repetition Trials of Standard Multiple-Choice Benchmarks
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical measurement of answer consistency and non-determinism in small LLMs using standard benchmarks like MMLU-Redux and MedQA. While it mentions value alignment and safety as motivations for consistent behavior, it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, faith, morals, or ethics.
